notes: Sigstore cosign-inspired bundle signing: ed25519 + ed25519-hmac algs, per-key deterministic publicKeyHex via SHA-256(seed), canonical JSON payload (sorted metadata) signed with HMAC-SHA-256, semver enforcement (non-monotonic reject, optional bump direction check), tamper-evident previousDigest chain, verify() + verifyChain() with 6 status codes.
